pages.text: The four Clans live around a great lake. $(br2)$(li)$(l)ThunderClan$(): oak woods to the north-east, their camp in a stone hollow.$(li)$(l)ShadowClan$(): dark pines and marsh to the north-west.$(li)$(l)RiverClan$(): streams and reeds to the south-west.$(li)$(l)WindClan$(): open moor to the south-east.
pages.title: Who Lives Where

pages.text: The lake shore belongs to no Clan. Walk close to the water and you trespass on no one. $(br2)Watch the words near your hotbar: they tell you whose land you have entered. Twoleg horses graze in fields between RiverClan and WindClan.
